question.text: What must a never-licensed applicant finish before applying?

answer.text: The never-licensed must finish the substance course before applying, though some school-board driver courses substitute.

teaching.text: Anyone who has never held a license finishes the substance course before applying, although some school-board driver courses can take its place. Remember: Course first, then apply.

audio_scripts.must_match_card_back: The never-licensed must finish the substance course before applying, though some school-board driver courses substitute.

question.text: Which young drivers must finish the substance course to regain driving on hardship?

answer.text: Drivers under twenty-one suspended for BAL from point zero two to point zero five must finish that course for hardship return.

teaching.text: A driver under twenty-one suspended for a blood alcohol level from point zero two to point zero five completes the same course to return on a hardship basis. Remember: Under twenty-one, low alcohol level.

audio_scripts.must_match_card_back: Drivers under twenty-one suspended for BAL from point zero two to point zero five must finish that course for hardship return.

question.text: Which two groups does the substance course gate?

answer.text: The substance course gates every never-licensed applicant yet also gates under-twenty-one hardship return after low-BAL suspension.

teaching.text: The substance course has two gates: it stands in front of every first-time applicant and in front of a young driver's hardship return after a low-level suspension. Remember: New applicants and low-level youth.

audio_scripts.must_match_card_back: The substance course gates every never-licensed applicant yet also gates under-twenty-one hardship return after low-BAL suspension.

question.text: When does improvement school become mandatory?

answer.text: Improvement school turns mandatory after an at-fault injury crash, two costly crashes in two years, or red-light, bus, racing, or reckless convictions.

teaching.text: School is required after an at-fault crash with injury, two costly crashes in two years, or convictions for red lights, school bus passing, racing or reckless driving. Remember: Serious crash or conviction forces school.

audio_scripts.must_match_card_back: Improvement school turns mandatory after an at-fault injury crash, two costly crashes in two years, or red-light, bus, racing, or reckless convictions.
audio_scripts.must_match_memory_hook: Serious crash or conviction forces school

question.text: Who may elect improvement school instead of points?

answer.text: Non-criminal violators outside commercial rigs may elect school over points unless speeding past thirty miles per hour over, earning an eighteen percent penalty cut.

teaching.text: A driver with a non-criminal ticket outside a commercial vehicle may choose school over points, unless the speeding was more than thirty over, and the penalty drops eighteen percent. Remember: Elect school, skip the points.

audio_scripts.must_match_card_back: Non-criminal violators outside commercial rigs may elect school over points unless speeding past thirty miles per hour over, earning an eighteen percent penalty cut.

question.text: How does forced improvement school differ from elected school?

answer.text: Improvement school is forced by crashes and convictions but elected for plain moving violations to dodge points.

teaching.text: Crashes and serious convictions order a driver to school, while an ordinary moving ticket lets the driver choose school to keep points off. Remember: Forced by crashes, chosen for tickets.

audio_scripts.must_match_card_back: Improvement school is forced by crashes and convictions but elected for plain moving violations to dodge points.
audio_scripts.must_match_memory_hook: Forced by crashes, chosen for tickets

question.text: What conditions allow electing school, and what does it save?

answer.text: Election needs a non-criminal, non-commercial ticket below thirty miles per hour over, and pays an eighteen percent penalty cut.

teaching.text: Choosing school needs a non-criminal ticket, outside a commercial vehicle, below thirty miles per hour over, and it cuts the penalty by eighteen percent. Remember: Small ticket, smaller penalty.

audio_scripts.must_match_card_back: Election needs a non-criminal, non-commercial ticket below thirty miles per hour over, and pays an eighteen percent penalty cut.

question.text: What insurance protection does electing school give, and when does it fail?

answer.text: Electing drivers dodge premium hikes and nonrenewal for the infraction, except after a second strike in eighteen months, a third in thirty-six, or speeding past fifteen over.

teaching.text: Electing school keeps that infraction from raising premiums or ending coverage, except after a second strike in eighteen months, a third in thirty-six, or speeding more than fifteen over. Remember: One shelter, repeat strikes break it.

audio_scripts.must_match_card_back: Electing drivers dodge premium hikes and nonrenewal for the infraction, except after a second strike in eighteen months, a third in thirty-six, or speeding past fifteen over.
audio_scripts.must_match_memory_hook: One shelter, repeat strikes break it

question.text: How often may a driver elect school, and what must reach the clerk?

answer.text: Points stay off with withheld adjudication, elections recur no sooner than twelve months apart and five per lifetime, and the clerk gets notice plus a fee within thirty days.

teaching.text: With adjudication withheld the points stay off, a driver can elect only once every twelve months and five times in life, and the clerk needs notice and a fee within thirty days. Remember: Once a year, five lifetime.

audio_scripts.must_match_card_back: Points stay off with withheld adjudication, elections recur no sooner than twelve months apart and five per lifetime, and the clerk gets notice plus a fee within thirty days.

question.text: What can advanced driver improvement courses restore?

answer.text: Advanced courses restore point, habitual-offender, or court-ordered suspensions and can rescue out-of-state citations.

teaching.text: Advanced improvement courses restore licenses suspended for points, habitual-offender status or court orders, and can help with out-of-state citations. Remember: Advanced course restores suspended licenses.

audio_scripts.must_match_card_back: Advanced courses restore point, habitual-offender, or court-ordered suspensions and can rescue out-of-state citations.

question.text: What triggers a DUI program, and what do senior courses offer?

answer.text: DUI programs follow unlawful alcohol levels, test refusals, or intoxication and drug convictions, while courses for drivers past sixty-five refresh habits and may trim insurance.

teaching.text: DUI programs follow unlawful alcohol levels, test refusals and intoxication or drug convictions, while courses for drivers older than sixty-five refresh habits and may lower insurance. Remember: DUI program, senior refresher.

audio_scripts.must_match_card_back: DUI programs follow unlawful alcohol levels, test refusals, or intoxication and drug convictions, while courses for drivers past sixty-five refresh habits and may trim insurance.

question.text: When does the premium shelter from electing school collapse?

answer.text: Premium shelter covers one infraction but collapses on a second strike in eighteen months, a third in thirty-six, or fifteen miles per hour over.

teaching.text: The insurance shelter covers one infraction, but a second strike within eighteen months, a third within thirty-six, or fifteen over breaks it. Remember: Repeat strikes end the shelter.

audio_scripts.must_match_card_back: Premium shelter covers one infraction but collapses on a second strike in eighteen months, a third in thirty-six, or fifteen miles per hour over.

question.text: How are school elections spaced and capped?

answer.text: Elections space twelve months apart with five per lifetime, and the clerk needs notice plus a fee inside thirty days.

teaching.text: Elections must sit at least twelve months apart with five allowed in a lifetime, and the clerk needs notice and payment within thirty days. Remember: Twelve months apart, five total.

audio_scripts.must_match_card_back: Elections space twelve months apart with five per lifetime, and the clerk needs notice plus a fee inside thirty days.

question.text: Which course track fits suspensions, intoxication cases and older drivers?

answer.text: Advanced courses cure suspensions, DUI programs answer intoxication cases, and senior courses refresh drivers past sixty-five.

teaching.text: Three tracks: advanced courses fix suspensions, DUI programs handle intoxication cases, and senior courses refresh drivers past sixty-five. Remember: Advanced, DUI, senior tracks.

audio_scripts.must_match_card_back: Advanced courses cure suspensions, DUI programs answer intoxication cases, and senior courses refresh drivers past sixty-five.

question.text: What do the license examinations confirm?

answer.text: Examinations confirm sign reading, law knowledge, vision minimums, and safe-driving ability.

teaching.text: The exams make sure you can read signs, know the laws, meet the vision minimum and drive safely. Remember: Signs, laws, eyes, safe driving.

audio_scripts.must_match_card_back: Examinations confirm sign reading, law knowledge, vision minimums, and safe-driving ability.

question.text: What is the fifth exam purpose, and where are tests given?

answer.text: The fifth exam purpose bars impairing physical or mental conditions, and tests run at service centers, school programs, or approved third parties.

teaching.text: The fifth purpose is screening out impairing physical or mental conditions, and testing happens at service centers, school programs or approved third parties. Remember: Centers, schools, approved providers.

audio_scripts.must_match_card_back: The fifth exam purpose bars impairing physical or mental conditions, and tests run at service centers, school programs, or approved third parties.

question.text: How do school-program, third-party and online testing work?

answer.text: School-program results enter official records with random retests possible, third parties serve all ages in person, and minors may test knowledge online.

teaching.text: School-program results enter the state record and may be randomly retested, third parties test all ages in person, and minors can take the knowledge test online. Remember: Minors may test knowledge online.

audio_scripts.must_match_card_back: School-program results enter official records with random retests possible, third parties serve all ages in person, and minors may test knowledge online.

question.text: Which exams do original applicants take?

answer.text: Original applicants take vision and hearing, knowledge, and skills exams, and lens wearers must drive corrected while telescopic aids never qualify.

teaching.text: New applicants take vision and hearing, knowledge and skills exams; anyone who needs lenses drives with them, and telescopic aids are never allowed. Remember: Eyes and ears, knowledge, skills.

audio_scripts.must_match_card_back: Original applicants take vision and hearing, knowledge, and skills exams, and lens wearers must drive corrected while telescopic aids never qualify.

question.text: What vision standards apply on the vision exam?

answer.text: Vision passes at twenty over forty either eye, refers at twenty over fifty, conditions twenty over seventy on a better-than-twenty over two hundred worst eye, demands twenty over forty from a sole good eye, and spans one hundred thirty degrees.

teaching.text: Twenty over forty in either eye passes, twenty over fifty is referred, twenty over seventy can pass with conditions, one good eye must reach twenty over forty, and the field must reach one hundred thirty degrees. Remember: Pass, refer, condition, wide field.

audio_scripts.must_match_card_back: Vision passes at twenty over forty either eye, refers at twenty over fifty, conditions twenty over seventy on a better-than-twenty over two hundred worst eye, demands twenty over forty from a sole good eye, and spans one hundred thirty degrees.

question.text: Where can each kind of license testing happen?

answer.text: Service centers, school programs with random retests, and third parties all test, with minors online for knowledge only.

teaching.text: Service centers, school programs with random retests and approved third parties all give tests, and only minors' knowledge tests move online. Remember: Online covers knowledge only.

audio_scripts.must_match_card_back: Service centers, school programs with random retests, and third parties all test, with minors online for knowledge only.

question.text: How do the vision pass, referral and condition lines differ?

answer.text: Vision clears at twenty over forty, detours at twenty over fifty, conditions twenty over seventy on the weaker eye, and always spans one hundred thirty degrees.

teaching.text: The vision ladder runs pass at twenty over forty, referral at twenty over fifty, conditional approval at twenty over seventy, and a one hundred thirty degree field every time. Remember: Clear, detour, then condition.

audio_scripts.must_match_card_back: Vision clears at twenty over forty, detours at twenty over fifty, conditions twenty over seventy on the weaker eye, and always spans one hundred thirty degrees.

question.text: What does the knowledge exam cover?

answer.text: The knowledge exam holds fifty multiple-choice items on traffic laws, safe practices, and control identification.

teaching.text: The knowledge exam is multiple choice and covers traffic laws, safe driving practices and identifying a vehicle's controls. Remember: Laws, safe practices, controls.

audio_scripts.must_match_card_back: The knowledge exam holds fifty multiple-choice items on traffic laws, safe practices, and control identification.

question.text: What subjects does the knowledge test span?

answer.text: The knowledge test spans fifty items across laws, safe practices, and control identification.

teaching.text: Study three subjects for the knowledge test: traffic laws, safe practices and how to identify the controls. Remember: Laws, practices, control identification.

audio_scripts.must_match_card_back: The knowledge test spans fifty items across laws, safe practices, and control identification.

question.text: What car must a skills candidate bring?

answer.text: Skills candidates supply a plated, insured, roadworthy car, rejected for bad equipment, glass, tags, doors, seats, signals, bumpers, or low-speed build.

teaching.text: You bring your own plated, insured and roadworthy car, and it fails for bad equipment, glass, tags, doors, seats, signals, bumpers or a low-speed design. Remember: Plated, insured, roadworthy car.

audio_scripts.must_match_card_back: Skills candidates supply a plated, insured, roadworthy car, rejected for bad equipment, glass, tags, doors, seats, signals, bumpers, or low-speed build.

question.text: Why can a skills-test car be rejected?

answer.text: The skills car must be plated, insured, and sound, failing on equipment, glass, tags, doors, seats, signals, or bumpers.

teaching.text: Before the test, check the plate, insurance, glass, doors, seats, signals and bumpers, because any of them can get the car rejected. Remember: Bad equipment fails the car.

audio_scripts.must_match_card_back: The skills car must be plated, insured, and sound, failing on equipment, glass, tags, doors, seats, signals, or bumpers.

question.text: Which maneuvers open the skills test?

answer.text: Tested maneuvers run crossing approaches, fifty-foot mirror-free backing, three-to-four-second gaps, full stops, and careful signal obedience.

teaching.text: The test opens with crossing approaches, fifty feet of backing without mirrors, three-to-four-second gaps, full stops and obeying signals. Remember: Back fifty feet, no mirrors.

audio_scripts.must_match_card_back: Tested maneuvers run crossing approaches, fifty-foot mirror-free backing, three-to-four-second gaps, full stops, and careful signal obedience.

question.text: Which further maneuvers does the skills test cover?

answer.text: Further maneuvers cover yielding, grade parking, safe passing, and one hundred-foot signaled turns.

teaching.text: More maneuvers follow: yielding, parking on a grade, passing safely, and turns signaled one hundred feet ahead. Remember: Yield, park on grades, pass.

audio_scripts.must_match_card_back: Further maneuvers cover yielding, grade parking, safe passing, and one hundred-foot signaled turns.

question.text: Which distances and gaps are fixed in the maneuvers?

answer.text: Maneuver numbers fix fifty-foot backing, three-to-four-second gaps, and one hundred-foot signaled turns.

teaching.text: Three numbers fix the maneuvers: back up fifty feet, keep three to four seconds behind, and signal turns one hundred feet early. Remember: Back fifty, signal one hundred.

audio_scripts.must_match_card_back: Maneuver numbers fix fifty-foot backing, three-to-four-second gaps, and one hundred-foot signaled turns.

question.text: Which final maneuvers end the skills test?

answer.text: Final maneuvers demand lane discipline, quick stops, centered parking, a twenty-to-forty-foot three-point turn, and proper posture, with feedback after and licenses on passing.

teaching.text: The test ends with lane discipline, quick stops, centered parking, a three-point turn in twenty to forty feet and good posture, then feedback and a license if you pass. Remember: Lanes, quick stop, three-point turn.

audio_scripts.must_match_card_back: Final maneuvers demand lane discipline, quick stops, centered parking, a twenty-to-forty-foot three-point turn, and proper posture, with feedback after and licenses on passing.

question.text: How much space does the three-point turn use?

answer.text: The three-point turn fits a twenty-to-forty-foot space with posture held throughout, and passing earns the license.

teaching.text: The three-point turn fits in twenty to forty feet, posture counts the whole time, and passing the test earns the license. Remember: Turn within twenty to forty feet.

audio_scripts.must_match_card_back: The three-point turn fits a twenty-to-forty-foot space with posture held throughout, and passing earns the license.
audio_scripts.must_match_memory_hook: Turn within twenty to forty feet
